name: rail-authorization-no-recourse
represents: The rail's default flow: verify authorization, execute the service, settle, then respond. Nothing is added on top of settlement.
profile_v1_violations: no verifier registry violates minVerifiers >= 3 * maxAssignments + 5
maxBadGain, maxReviewCost, verifierWrongPenalty have no defined value
cannot_express: no adjudication object exists, so there is no case to open and no verdict state to observe
no receipt and no anchor, so a settlement cannot be tied to a specific request or response
no refund source of any kind; a settled payment is final on arrival
no non-delivery procedure, so the two-generals situation is simply unresolved
no notion of seller identity carrying liability across purchases
harness_special_cases: ground truth for correct/incorrect delivery is held only by the controller, outside the runtime, and never enters any on-chain or protocol state
the metrics 'detection rate', 'adjudication latency', 'verifier accountability' are undefined, not zero; the envelope must record them as null with reason 'no adjudication object'
unrecovered-value equals settled-value for every cheating transaction by construction; the run is a calibration of the metric pipeline, not a measurement of a mechanism
the D-sweep does not apply; emit one point at D = 0 and mark the other sweep points as not-applicable
scenarios F4, S1, S2, S3, A1 have no defined procedure; score them 'undefined' rather than 'fail', and record which property has no carrier

expected_outcome.d_sweep: Flat. D is structurally absent, so the arm is a single point at D = 0 and does not move when the treatment arm's D moves.

cheater_scenarios.steady_cheat: Cheater net gain equals g times every settlement in the run. No term bounds it; exposure is not g*(1/p + lambda*L) but g*lambda*T_run, growing in run length.
cheater_scenarios.S5_burst: Burst is invisible: there is no cap, no bucket, no rejection. The burst simply multiplies the leak.
cheater_scenarios.S6_patient_defector: Indistinguishable from an honest seller before and after the defection. Nothing is recovered.

expected_outcome.honest_seller_cost: Zero locked capital, zero delayed proceeds, zero anchor gas. This arm is the lower bound of the cost axis and the upper bound of the leak axis; it exists to anchor both.

operating_point_note: Values written "op:<expr>" are read from experiments/operating-point.json (see experiments/controller/operating_point.py); this file keeps no copy of g, v, p, L or the rates.
